name: @cyclone-ui/trace
description: Trace, the building block of the Cyclone UI AI components: a list of lines that report what an agent did, each an icon, a one-line title that truncates and an optional description such as a duration or count. A line's status shows running work with a shimmering title, failed work in the danger color and pending work dimmed. Trace.Collapsible expands a line into its detail (text, code or nested lines) and can be controlled; Trace.Link opens a page and Trace.Button opens a dialog, sheet or popover. Use it for reasoning, tool calls, sources, plans and tasks.
